name: 🏋️Lift Everything!
desc:
🗣️ Welcome to Lift Everything!

Everything you see can be lifted!

How To Play:
🔥 Lift anything and everything to build Strength!
💨 Keep grinding gains, even offline!
🏋️‍♂️ Unlock crazier objects to lift as your strength grows!
⚔️ Fight other players to prove your dominance!
✨ Collect and show off rare pets as you rise to the top!

Remember, you gain strength while you are offline!💪
Like & Favorite the game and join the group for FREE rewards!👍
